# Satellite Paraguay - Cron Jobs
# Generated by scripts/generate_crontab.py
# Install: crontab scripts/crontab.txt
#
# Schedule legend:
#   m h dom mon dow command

# ====== Hourly: Quick health check ======
0 * * * * cd /root/satellite-paraguay && python3 scripts/alert_cron_failures.py --since-hours=2 >> logs/cron_hourly.log 2>&1

# ====== Daily: Update data, run analysis ======
30 2 * * * cd /root/satellite-paraguay && python3 scripts/verify_reproducibility.py >> logs/cron_daily.log 2>&1

# ====== Weekly: Full pipeline run (Sunday 06:00 UTC) ======
0 6 * * 0 cd /root/satellite-paraguay && bash scripts/weekly_run.sh >> logs/cron_weekly.log 2>&1

# ====== Monthly: Dependency audit + cleanup (1st of month) ======
0 4 1 * * cd /root/satellite-paraguay && python3 scripts/audit_dependencies.py >> logs/cron_monthly.log 2>&1

# ====== Quarterly: Performance benchmarks + report ======
0 5 1 */3 * cd /root/satellite-paraguay && python3 -m pytest tests/test_performance.py -m performance --no-cov --benchmark-only --benchmark-autosave >> logs/cron_quarterly.log 2>&1

# ====== Hourly: Log rotation (prevent disk fill) ======
0 * * * * cd /root/satellite-paraguay && find logs/ -name "*.log" -mtime +7 -delete && find outputs/weekly -name "*.log" -mtime +30 -delete

# ====== Daily: Backup outputs to remote ======
0 23 * * * cd /root/satellite-paraguay && tar czf /tmp/satellite-paraguay-$(date +\%Y\%m\%d).tar.gz outputs/ && (rsync -avz /tmp/satellite-paraguay-$(date +\%Y\%m\%d).tar.gz remote:/backups/ || echo "Backup failed" >> logs/cron_daily.log)
